about: Files moved here byte for byte from bitfield-packages (packages/gmail-mailbox-decoder): each names its source path and commit, the identity of its source bytes and of its bytes here. The first commit that holds them is the byte copy; later commits change import paths only. A file named .held is the same bytes with its test name taken off so the repository test does not run it; the reason is under `held`. `not_carried` names package files that were left in the package and why.

held.tools/conversations/do-work/__tests__/te: imports conversation_snapshot_fold, the co-mounted fold; the Workshop's fold is conversations/read-data/snapshot_fold.py under another name

not_carried.packages/gmail-mailbox-decoder/.gitignor: package README, package.json or ignore file; this folder has its own README
not_carried.packages/gmail-mailbox-decoder/README.md: package README, package.json or ignore file; this folder has its own README
not_carried.packages/gmail-mailbox-decoder/things-to: the package boundary file: record contracts, actions and surfaces for the retired package runtime (slot workflows, owner targets); not carried
not_carried.packages/gmail-mailbox-decoder/do-work/c: reads an OAuth credential blob from a file and calls the Gmail API with it: a provider call with a credential; the door hands credentials by handle through a row's invoke.connection, so it needs that swap first
